name: Teak Wood Dining Set (Table + 4 Chairs)
description: Solid teak wood square dining set with matching ladder-back chairs. Durable, elegant and ideal for everyday family use.
details: This teak wood dining set includes a solid square table and four matching chairs. The table features a smooth teak top with sturdy legs. The chairs have a classic ladder-back design with horizontal slats, comfortable seating and a natural teak finish. Made from quality teak wood, the set is strong, long-lasting and suitable for daily use. Perfect for Sri Lankan homes looking for a practical and stylish dining solution.
